child.label: Reading Feelings & Character
child.description: Questions about how a person in a short everyday scene would feel as a result, or how you would describe that person's character from what they did.
child.not_for: Why the person acted, what they needed to do first, or what they or others will do next (use Reading Motives & Plans). Preferences about dating, partners, friends, family or coworkers (use those sibling nodes).
examples: Riley stayed up all night to finish the project. How would Riley feel afterwards?
Jordan gave his lunch to a hungry classmate. How would you describe Jordan?
Casey's friend forgot her birthday. How would Casey feel as a result?

child.label: Reading Motives & Plans
child.description: Questions about why a person in a short everyday scene did something, what they had to do beforehand, and what they or others will want to do or will happen next.
child.not_for: How the person feels or what their character is like (use Reading Feelings & Character). Preferences about dating, partners, friends, family or coworkers (use those sibling nodes).
examples: Lee bought new shoes after his old ones got a hole. Why did Lee do this?
Aubrey got a flat tire and pulled over. What will Aubrey want to do next?
Ash hosted a dinner party. What did Ash need to do before this?
